title: 설비 정지 발생 빈도 (요일별 시간대)
data_code:
import pandas as pd
# Extract hour from '시작시각' string (e.g., '10:43' -> 10)
df['시간대'] = df['시작시각'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
# Extract weekday name in Korean from '일자'
# pandas day_name() returns English. We map it to Korean.
day_map = {
    'Monday': '월',
    'Tuesday': '화',
    'Wednesday': '수',
    'Thursday': '목',
    'Friday': '금',
    'Saturday': '토',
    'Sunday': '일'
}
df['요일'] = pd.to_datetime(df['일자']).dt.day_name().map(day_map)
